finding: CLASS 1 (all setup violators): the LAST hop into a destination block. Every relay-to-relay / station hop meets TT setup (worst +209.9 ps, f_hrq). The stand-in block captures on the ROOT clk while the lane arrives on its forwarded clock, which has accumulated ~115 ps per relay ck->ck_o hop (tvS s_0N->s_0S, 16 stages: -6.3 ns; hrq 682-b: -3.5 ns; frame x lanes: -2.4 ns). Under neighbour-relative clocking the receiver must capture on the ARRIVING forwarded clock (frame xk / slice ck_in ports, then its fixed-latency crossing), so this is a case-model gap, not a die defect: dv_diecase stand-in libs need a forwarded-clock input pin per input lane (die.v wires the lane last fck to it) before the pilot can judge the arrival hop. Hold (-1,067 ps) not yet classified.
